text:
kiran: heads-up: planning a small runtime kernel + quant build swap for eu-west1 tonight during 00:30-01:30 UTC change window. it's a narrow slice (5%) to validate compat and perf.

matt: nice. what's the rollback criteria? CPU/latency/regressions thresholds?

kiran: primary smoke: p95 token latency + error rate. auto-rollback if p95 increases >15% or error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. also manual rollback on any KV-cache OOM or memory growth >10% on average.

alejandra: adding checks: end-to-end sample prompts and model checksum match verification. can we pin traffic to variant v2-quant-lite for the slice? need config for deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created: rollout_id=roll-6159876543, slice=5%, regions=[eu-west1], variant=v2-quant-lite, start=6159878200, stop=6159881800. Steps:
- preflight hooks
- canary slice
- monitor 10m
- ramp to 5% steady
- auto-rollback on trigger

matt: deploy-bot shows start later than window? start timestamp ok for our window?

kiran: start is the queued time (00:30 UTC). that's within window.

alejandra: preflight checklist:
- build artifact checksum verified
- kernel ABI compat smoke (invocations against small model)
- quantized matmul microbench (latency + throughput)
- KV cache warmstart test
- memory pressure regression run

kiran: i'm running the abi smoke now. results in ~5m. will paste logs.

deploy-bot: preflight: artifact checksum ok (sha256: f9a3...7b2).

ops-bot: canary telemetry warmup started. hooking to metric group: runtime.canary.euw.p95, runtime.canary.euw.err_rate, runtime.canary.euw.mem_rss.

kiran: ABI smoke: command run:
```
./smoke_runner --target=staging-edge --kernel=kernel-v13 --quant=v2-quant-lite --samples=100
```
returns: 100/100 success, model output checksums match baseline. p50/p95 within 3% of baseline.

alejandra: matmul microbench: baseline p95=12ms, new build p95=13.8ms -> +15% borderline. need to ensure KV caching hides this for real traffic. set monitoring threshold to 18ms (15% trigger).

matt: also gate on memory RSS: baseline 6.2GB, new 6.9GB -> +11%. that breaches our >10% manual rollback rule. can we re-run with tuned allocator?

kiran: tried allocator tweak (jemalloc hint), reran bench: RSS=6.3GB now, p95=14.1ms. still +14% latency but memory ok. propose to proceed with canary and watch closely, with manual abort if p95 > 18ms.

oncall-rachel: i'll be on-call during the window. add me to pager policy and put my primary-oncall contact in the rollout description.

deploy-bot: rollout updated: pager=oncall-rachel, alert-conditions=[p95>18ms|5m,p99>30ms|5m,err_rate>0.5%|5m,mem_increase>10%|3m].

ops-bot: quick note: spike in disk swap seen on a small batch during warmstart in staging (~30s). not on production. watch for swap churn.

matt: ok, final ask: include a two-minute quiesce before switching traffic so old KV snapshots flush. otherwise we'll see cold-cache noise. add pre-swap delay=120s.

kiran: added pre-swap quiesce=120s to rollout. final runbook pinned in the rollout: steps + rollback criteria + contact.

alejandra: I'll draft the release-note blurb after the slice passes 30m: include perf delta, memory, and KV compatibility note.

deploy-bot: rollout roll-6159876543 is in the queue. will post status updates here when it hits each step. :rocket:

oncall-rachel: ack, i'll monitor and escalate if anything weird in the first 10m. :eyes:

matt: thanks all. if we get persistent p95 > 18ms for 5m, i'll trigger the rollback and follow the rollback checklist.

kiran: thanks — starting final artifact bake and will update when rollout is live.

deploy-bot: status: preflight complete, canary slice scheduled.
